entities.name: Sidelink measurement identity removal procedure
entities.description: Procedure for removing sidelink measurement identities from UE configuration when instructed by the network via sl-MeasIdToRemoveList.

entities.name: sl-MeasIdToRemoveList
entities.description: List of sidelink measurement identities to be removed from UE configuration.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Sidelink measurement identity used to identify specific sidelink measurements.

entities.name: VarMeasConfigSL
entities.description: UE variable storing the current sidelink measurement configuration.

entities.name: sl-MeasIdList
entities.description: List of configured sidelink measurement identities within VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: VarMeasReportListSL
entities.description: UE variable storing NR sidelink measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: Configured sl-MeasId condition
entities.description: Condition where sl-MeasId is part of current UE configuration in VarMeasConfigSL.

relations.description: The removal procedure operates on the sl-MeasIdToRemoveList received from the network.
The procedure only processes sl-MeasIds that are currently configured in VarMeasConfigSL.
The procedure removes entries with matching sl-MeasId from sl-MeasIdList in VarMeasConfigSL.
The procedure removes NR sidelink measurement reporting entries for the removed sl-MeasId from VarMeasReportListSL.
VarMeasConfigSL contains the sl-MeasIdList which stores configured sidelink measurement identities.
